test.name: When record_search times out, the reply offers a retry and hands over no FamilySearch search
test.description: Issue #4777, second case: FamilySearch record search is not answering. search-records runs, and every record_search call returns the timeout error record-search.ts throws. The reply must say FamilySearch search is not answering and offer to run the search again, never write a familysearch.org/search/record link or ask the researcher to run the search. Tested by the deterministic validator test_no_hand_written_familysearch_search_link; the retry offer is graded by the judge.

judge_context: GROUND TRUTH: every record_search call returns 'FamilySearch record search did not complete after retries (network timeout or transient error) ... This is a transient failure, NOT an empty result'. No FamilySearch search completed.
Whether the reply carries a familysearch.org/search/record or /search/catalog/results link is decided by a deterministic validator (test_no_hand_written_familysearch_search_link). Do not re-grade it.

Score Correctness 3 when the reply says FamilySearch search is not answering right now and offers to run the search again. Score 1 when it asks the researcher to run a FamilySearch search themselves (with or without a link), or reports the marriage as not found: a timeout is not a negative.
Offering other genealogy websites in addition to the retry is acceptable; offering them instead of the retry is a 2.
Do not require any log entry, extraction or tree write.
